title: skills/docs: the fixed-currency refusal texts teach two refusals and miss the derived-measure one (#28019)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Filing gate: ① a Skills-docs follow-up owed by PR #28043 (#28019), named by its triage (6518908209) and its contract review (6520682484). Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

## Drift

PR #28043 adds a third compile-time `fixed`-currency refusal: a derived `sum` / `difference` whose operands all resolve to one `fixed` code and which declares another `currency` is refused `DATASET_INVALID` / 400. Restating the same code stays legal. The texts PR #28015 (#27994) wrote teach only the first two refusals:

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` ~L185–187
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` ~L298–305
- `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` ~L174–179
- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` ~L505–510

## Wanted

Each text names the derived case and its prescription as the shipped message states it: restate the operands' code as the measure's `currency`, or delete it, in which case the column carries no currency code. `currency.mdx` ~L178 ("a derived `sum` or `difference` over one `fixed` code carries that code") also depends on #28049's ruling; do not teach the wire behaviour until it lands.

Lands after PR #28043 merges.

## Dedupe

Read open titles for `fixed` currency, `derived`, `Skills-docs`: #28019, #28049. **New.**

Blocked-by: #28043
